sloka: एवम् ब्रुवाणम् काकुत्स्थम् प्रतिवार्य शुचि स्मिता ।उवाच सीता संहृष्टा चद्मना हृत चेतना ॥३-४३-९॥
transliteration: evam bruvāṇam kākutstham prativārya śuci smitā ।uvāca sītā saṁhṛṣṭā cadmanā hṛta cetanā ॥3-43-9॥

translations.english: O prince O longarmed one, this deer has captivated my mind. Fetch him for me.This will be our playmate.
